snippet.title: FOOS Trailer - Coming July 31st, 2025!
snippet.description: FOOS is my first indie game, an arcade game inspired by Foosball and PONG. Play against a series of opponents with unique abilities and beat your high scores in the challenge modes! Releasing on Steam July 31st, 2025!!
